text:
Elena: Heads-up 1:00 lunch experiment 11 Im bringing a big pot of shio-dashi ramen base. Pop by between 12:55-1:15 for a quick bowl. BYO bowl/utensils if you can. :ramen:
Marco: Amazing. Do you need me to bring anything? I can do a GF noodle option or some rice.
Elena: If you can bring GF noodles that would be ideal. I only packed regular noodles. Thanks!
Ava: Small ask: could we use the induction hotplate instead of the microwave? The microwave line gets long and its awkward during standup. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Elena: Yep hotplate it is  I'll set it on the counter and put a timer sign. Microwaves reserved for quick reheats.
Priya: Allergy note: Im allergic to tree nuts. Will there be any sesame or nut toppings?
Elena: No nuts in the base. I have sesame oil for drizzle I'll separate the bottle and label it.
kitchen-bot: FYI: Please wash any borrowed utensils and clear the counter when done. Dishwasher cycle at 4:45pm. :broom: :sparkles:
Marco: Also bringing a tiny rice cooker with pre-cooked brown rice for whoever prefers rice. I'll bring tamari (gluten-free) and two ladles.
Ava: Tiny signup I left on the counter sticky so we don't double up on chili oil or nori. Paste this if you want to add:
```
- Marco: brown rice + tamari
- Elena: dashi base, scallions, soft-boiled eggs
- Ava: chili oil (mild), toasted sesame sprinkle
- Priya: pickled radish (labelled)
```
Priya: I'll clearly label pickles and add an allergy sticker. Also happy to transport bowls to courtyard for folks who dont want to eat indoors.
Elena: Thanks! Also one fridge/cleaning PSA: if you use the communal bowls, please rinse before dropping in the dishwasher. Dried noodle bits jam the pump. :sweat_smile:
Ava: Can we agree: rinse, scrape, then stack. No noodle clumps in the machine  our SRE likes his mornings quiet. :coffee:
Marco: I'll volunteer to be dishwasher monitor today for 10 minutes after lunch, promise not to scrutinize anyones spoon technique. :ok_hand:
Priya: Court yard plan sounds good if smell is an issue. Elena, if youre opening a window maybe also put a small "lunch in progress" sign so delivery folks don't wander in. :shushing_face:
Elena: Will do. Sign text: "Ramen lunch: please excuse aromas  not a building fire." :grimacing:
kitchen-bot: Note: communal cooking allowed but please put a dish towel under hot pots and use the trivet. Office policy reminder posted in the kitchen channel. :clipboard:
